field_declaration.nullable: Allow an explicitly present JSON null value.
field_declaration.privacy: Optional field privacy override; otherwise inherit entity privacy.
field_declaration.required: Whether a declared field must be present when an import creates a Node; key-matched updates may omit it and retain the current value.
field_declaration.searchable: Index public string values for memory_search_manage action=text.
field_declaration.type: Optional enforced JSON type; omit to keep the field dynamic.

guide.errors: Expected failures are JSON objects with code, message, details, and retryable. Never silently switch memories after an error.

operations.analysis: memory_ingest_manage writes analytical attributes and metrics. Use a Node ID from query bindings; metrics are immutable observations.
operations.configure: memory_configure create initializes and attach validates. SQLite requires database/evidence_root; PostgreSQL requires connection_env/schema/evidence_root. Paths are absolute; connection_env names a DSN variable, not its value.
operations.describe: memory_ontology_manage declares optional namespace/entity metadata and validation. Imports may introduce undeclared fields and types.
operations.import: memory_ingest_manage action=jsonl_import reads a server-local JSONL file, one JSON object per line. key is an ordered typed tuple used to find a current Node. Required declared fields must be present when a record creates a Node; key-matched updates patch only present fields and may omit required fields.
operations.join: memory_relation_manage action=materialize creates exact typed joins. Source arrays expand unique non-null values and Cartesian products; targets stay scalar. Joins are never inferred or rerun automatically.
operations.provenance: Search/query results return record/source/run/fragment identifiers. Use memory_explain_manage for provenance and evidence managers for bounded raw-byte status, reads, or verification.
operations.query: memory_query_manage action=execute is the general relational/graph read surface. Non-count rows bind aliases to canonical Node IDs.

guide.purpose: Use Analytical Memory through MCP without database access or source-code knowledge. Resources describe current data shape; tools perform bounded typed operations.

results.common: Every tool result includes memory. Fingerprints identify its contract. source_id, batch_id, run_id, fragment_id, and evidence_digest are provenance identities, not business keys.
results.evidence: availability is present or missing; verification is unverified, verified, or corrupt. Read data_base64 until eof; audit complete=false or truncated=true means the requested bound did not cover the catalog.
results.import: records is accepted line count; created_nodes and updated_nodes split upserts; attributes_written counts present fields; ontology_delta names newly observed shape.
results.join: created_relations is new active edges. skipped_unmatched and skipped_null_or_missing explain non-materialized source nodes.
results.query: rows contain alias-to-Node-ID bindings and projections with direct provenance. count is used only for count queries. truncated means more rows exist beyond the requested limit.
results.replay: replayed=true means the same idempotent operation was already committed; returned IDs and counts describe that canonical operation.
results.search: results contain current target IDs and provenance. coverage reports eligible versus indexed facts and whether indexing is complete.
results.traversal: nodes and edges carry depth; truncated means the result limit stopped the traversal. relation_id can be explained or deactivated.

safety.correction: memory_relation_deactivate corrects current graph state without deleting provenance. Evidence verify/audit append verification history.
safety.destructive: memory_node_delete cascades current attributes, relations, embeddings, and search documents but retains immutable evidence/provenance records.
safety.privacy: public is the default. private data is excluded from public export and external embedding. Semantic query text is sent to the configured commercial embedding provider.

selection.default: Omit memory on every tool to use the environment-selected default.
selection.named: Pass the same explicit memory name on every related tool call. There is no process-wide active selection and no fallback for unknown names.

workflow.action: Read memory://catalog and choose default or a named memory. For content discovery, read its summary; an empty default does not imply that named memories are empty.
Read capabilities or ontology only when the task needs them. Tool descriptions link actions to exact specs; read memory://operations only when the operation is not yet known.
Read the selected operation spec before calling a manager; use its exact payload schema and example.
Read memory://schema/current only for writes and pass its schema_fingerprint as the payload contract_fingerprint.
Read memory://schema/query-ir/current before action=execute on memory_query_manage. Use ontology names exactly.
Read the selected ontology before imports, joins, or queries and refresh it after shape-changing writes.

server_instructions: Start with memory://guide and memory://catalog. Use one memory name consistently; there is no active selection.
